subject: Subprocessor onboarding: relay partner proposal — evidence & export checklist
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@fintide.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@fintide.io
Date: 2026-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New relay partner — request for subprocessor roster and export evidence

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the call earlier — Fintide is reviewing the relay partner proposal you shared. Our procurement and security teams need the full subprocessor roster (including transient telemetry/relay services), an exportability matrix, and any evidence of onshore fallback or escrow arrangements before we can proceed to legal redlines.

Specifically we need: 
- Subprocessor names, country of processing, role (telemetry, caching, proxy, KMS), and whether customer data traverses each component.
- Any current or planned onshore fallback options for EU/UK customers.
- KMS/HSM jurisdiction and key residency (if applicable).
- A short evidence bundle (SOC2 exhibit, temp-access logs, or attestation) for any subprocessors handling PII.

Can you send a single packet we can attach to the SOW? Our timeline is tight — procurement would like the packet by EOD Friday.

Appreciate it,
Alex
Head of Procurement
Fintide Labs

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@fintide.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New relay partner — request for subprocessor roster and export evidence

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. We're assembling a concise packet. Quick notes before we pull materials: 

- We'll provide the current subprocessor roster (internal + third-party relays) with country and processing role.
- For telemetry/relay partners that are transient (short-lived containers), we'll include architecture export flows and a note on whether data is persisted.
- KMS jurisdiction: customer keys are supported via Azure Key Vault and optional HSM through our partners; we'll call out residency by model.
- Evidence: SOC 2 attestation for the affected subprocessors where available; otherwise we'll add engineering attestation and our last access audit snapshot.

Kimberly — can you pull the latest roster and KMS notes? Marissa — please prepare a short export_flow_diagram and an evidence checklist we can hand to Fintide (one-page). Jonas — I may need the temporary access audit (redacted) for relay-01 for the last 90 days.

We should aim to get the packet to Alex by EOD Pacific. If any piece is inconsistent with legal constraints, flag it now.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[attachment: procurement-checklist-template.docx (docx)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New relay partner — request for subprocessor roster and export evidence

All — pulling data now. Status: 
- Subprocessor roster: drafting spreadsheet (will mark transit vs persisted).
- KMS/HSM: short note ready (Azure Key Vault for hosted, partner HSM used for Dedicated customers; residency noted per region).
- SOC2 exhibits: two subprocessors have SOC2 reports; legal ok to share redacted attestations. Others will get engineering attestations.

I'll attach the spreadsheet + KMS note. Marissa, can you create the export_flow_diagram and add annotations for where data may cross borders? I'll redact service-account ids before we send externally.

Kimberly Park
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_subprocessor_roster_v3.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@fintide.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-06T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New relay partner — request for subprocessor roster and export evidence

Alex — attaching the packet we committed to. Contents (zipped for convenience):

1) redwood_subprocessor_roster_v3.xlsx — master roster with role, country, processing type (transient/persisted), and retention notes.
2) export_flow_diagram_v1.png — simplified diagram showing transit corridors and points where data may traverse EU/US boundaries.
3) procurement-checklist-reply.docx — short cover note mapping each requested item to the evidence included, plus contact for follow-up.
4) SOC2-exhibit-redacted.pdf (SOC2 exhibits for two subprocessors) — linked in Drive due to size.

A few clarifications up front: 
- The majority of relay processing is transient (in-memory KV caches, no long-term persistence). Where data is persisted by a partner, we've called it out in the roster and included retention and deletion controls.
- Onshore fallback: we currently offer EU onshore fallback for Dedicated customers via our EU-dedicated relay pool; that option requires a different SOW and a short lead time for capacity reservation — flagged in the procurement doc.
- KMS: for hosted deployments keys may be held in Azure Key Vault (regional); for Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed keys in a customer-owned KMS/HSM.

If you'd like, we can schedule a short handoff call tomorrow with engineering to walk the diagram and answer questions.

Links: Drive packet — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-relay-evidence
HubSpot record — https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[attachments: redwood_subprocessor_roster_v3.xlsx (xlsx); export_flow_diagram_v1.png (png); procurement-checklist-reply.docx (docx)]
